title: Sessions.
bodyText: The judge shall so arrange the sessions as to insure a prompt discharge of the business of the court.
bodyHtml: §501-3  Sessions.  The judge shall so arrange the sessions as to insure a prompt discharge of the business of the court. [L 1903, c 56, §4; RL 1925, §3193; RL 1935, §5002; RL 1945, §12602; RL 1955, §342-3; HRS §501-3]
